Our Story

Rooted in the
fertile lands of Morocco

Taramide was born from a deep love for Morocco’s botanical heritage. Our story begins in Er-Rich, in the province of Midelt a land where wild rosemary grows freely and the air carries its scent at every turn. We grew up here, and that fragrance has stayed with us ever since. Today, we harvest and transform aromatic and medicinal plants using time-honoured methods, bringing the purity of our homeland to customers around the world.

Every bottle reflects our commitment to quality carefully crafted from plant to extraction to preserve the full potency of each ingredient. Our founder, Ayoub Sabbane, personally ensures complete traceability at every step.

Natural

We work with wild plants grown naturally in their native environment.

Sustainable

Sourced within approximately 100 km of Midelt.

Certified

From wild harvest to finished product, quality is our commitment.

Our Process

From plant to bottle,
a unique expertise

A careful process that preserves the purity and integrity of our plants.

01

Wild plants

Wild plants grown randomly, without pesticides or chemical fertilizers and without any human intervention.

02

Harvest

Hand-picked at optimal hours to preserve the active compounds of each plant.

03

Distillation

Water steam distillation to extract essential oils and floral waters without solvents.

04

Packaging

They bottle, label, and quality-check products before shipping, and also supply bulk quantities for customers to bottle and label themselves.

Quality Guarantees

Certifications that
prove our commitment

Our products undergo the most rigorous controls, validated by independent national and international organizations.

Our commitment
Active

Agriculture Biologique

Certified organic production in accordance with recognized agricultural standards. This certification confirms that the wild plants are 100% organic, grown randomly and does not contain any synthetic chemicals or genetically modified organisms.

Active

Bio Maroc

Official certification under the Moroccan Organic Agriculture Label (MA-BIO-102). This certification guarantees that the products comply with Morocco’s national organic agriculture regulations and ensures the complete absence of synthetic chemical inputs.

Active

CCPB International

Certified and monitored by CCPB (Italy), an internationally recognized organic certification body. This certification confirms that the products meet European organic agriculture standards, ensuring traceability, quality, and environmentally sustainable production methods.

Active

ONSSA

Validated by the National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), Morocco. This approval confirms compliance with Moroccan sanitary and food safety regulations, ensuring that all products meet the required standards for quality and consumer protection.

Traceability from wild harvest to finished product.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is Taramide Cosmetics?

Taramide Cosmetics is a Moroccan company specializing in the production of 100% organic natural plant extracts, including aromatic and medicinal plants. The company focuses on high-quality, natural ingredients sourced from Morocco.

Are your products certified organic?

Yes. Our products are certified by recognized organizations such as BIO Maroc, CCPB, and ONSSA, ensuring that our plant extracts meet strict organic and quality standards.

Where is Taramide Cosmetics located?

Our company is based in Ksar Ousroutou, Sidi Aayad, Er-rich, Midelt, Morocco, where we work closely with local natural resources to produce premium plant extracts.

How can I contact Taramide Cosmetics?

You can contact us through the contact form or via WhatsApp by clicking the WhatsApp icon.
